diseases.name: Newcastle Disease
diseases.treatment: No specific treatment; supportive care: electrolytes, vitamins. Vaccination of remaining flock.
diseases.prevention: Vaccinate at 1 day, 21 days, 8 weeks. Biosecurity: isolate new birds, disinfect footwear.

diseases.name: Gumboro Disease (IBD)
diseases.treatment: No antiviral. Supportive care: warm environment, electrolyte water. Antibiotics for secondary infections.
diseases.prevention: Vaccinate breeders and chicks. Strict hygiene between batches.

diseases.name: Fowl Pox
symptoms: dark raised scabby lesions on comb/wattles
diseases.treatment: No treatment. Supportive: soft food, clean water. Apply iodine to lesions if severe.
diseases.prevention: Vaccination with fowl pox vaccine. Mosquito control.

diseases.name: Coccidiosis
diseases.treatment: Anticoccidial drugs in water. Supportive: vitamins A, D, K. Clean dry litter.
diseases.prevention: Use coccidiostats in feed. Keep litter dry. Rotate anticoccidials.

diseases.name: Marek's Disease
symptoms: leg paralysis (one leg forward, one back)
diseases.treatment: No treatment. Cull affected birds. Vaccinate day-old chicks.
diseases.prevention: Vaccinate at hatchery. Genetic resistance. Biosecurity.

diseases.name: Fowl Typhoid
diseases.treatment: Antibiotics (oxytetracycline, enrofloxacin). Disinfect house. Cull carriers.
diseases.prevention: Rodent control. Buy Salmonella-free stock. Biosecurity.

diseases.name: Infectious Bronchitis (IB)
diseases.treatment: No antiviral. Warm dry housing. Antibiotics for secondary bacteria.
diseases.prevention: Vaccination. All-in-all-out management.

diseases.name: Infectious Coryza
diseases.treatment: Sulphonamides, erythromycin, or oxytetracycline. Isolate sick birds.
diseases.prevention: Biosecurity. Vaccination available.

diseases.name: Mycoplasmosis (CRD)
diseases.treatment: Tylosin, enrofloxacin, or tetracyclines in water.
diseases.prevention: Buy Mycoplasma-free chicks. Biosecurity.

diseases.name: Avian Influenza (Low Path)
diseases.treatment: No treatment in Kenya (reportable). Quarantine, culling.
diseases.prevention: Biosecurity – prevent contact with wild waterfowl.

diseases.name: Pullorum Disease
diseases.treatment: No treatment. Cull entire flock. Disinfect house.
diseases.prevention: Buy from Pullorum-clean sources. Blood test breeders.

diseases.name: Egg Drop Syndrome (EDS)
diseases.treatment: No treatment. Vaccinate at 16-18 weeks. Supportive nutrition.
diseases.prevention: Vaccinate pullets before lay. Biosecurity.

diseases.name: Botulism
diseases.cause: Clostridium botulinum toxin from rotten feed/carcasses
diseases.treatment: Remove toxin source. Epsom salts. Supportive glucose water.
diseases.prevention: Dispose of dead birds immediately. No rotten vegetable matter.

diseases.name: Omphalitis (Mushy Chick)
diseases.treatment: Antibiotics (amoxycillin, enrofloxacin) in water. Warm brooder.
diseases.prevention: Disinfect hatchery equipment. Brooder hygiene.

diseases.name: Aspergillosis
diseases.treatment: Remove mouldy litter. Nystatin or itraconazole.
diseases.prevention: Dry clean litter. Avoid mouldy feed. Ventilation.

diseases.name: Necrotic Enteritis
diseases.treatment: Amoxycillin, penicillin, or bacitracin in water. Treat coccidiosis first.
diseases.prevention: Prevent coccidiosis. Avoid high-protein diets. Clean litter.

diseases.name: Vitamin A Deficiency
diseases.cause: Poor quality feed, lack of vitamin premix
diseases.treatment: Vitamin A supplement (10,000 IU/kg feed for 1 week). Add greens.
diseases.prevention: Use commercial feed with balanced vitamins. Offer fresh greens.

diseases.name: Cannibalism (Behavioural)
diseases.treatment: Reduce light. Provide pecking blocks. Increase methionine. Beak trimming (last resort).
diseases.prevention: Proper density (max 8-10 birds/m²). Balanced diet. Enrichment.

diseases.name: Heat Stress
diseases.treatment: Move to shade. Cool water with electrolytes/vitamin C. Mist fans.
diseases.prevention: Plant trees. Ventilation. Water always available. Feed early morning.

diseases.name: Newcastle Disease (Variant)
diseases.treatment: Supportive care. Vaccination with appropriate strain.
diseases.prevention: Vaccination. Biosecurity.
